Differences Between Groups as Segments

Source: R/figure-plots-forest.R
PlotGroupDifferences.Rd

One row per contrast or endpoint: a segment from zero to the estimate (not an interval) ending in a point, and a P-value text at the right. With marker = "colour" points, segments and text take significant_colour when q is below alpha and other_colour otherwise; with marker = "open" significant rows have filled points in significant_colour and the others open points with an open_colour edge, segments are drawn in segment_colour and the text is ink or muted. The x axis is symmetric around zero unless x_limits are given.

Usage

PlotGroupDifferences(
  data,
  row = "contrast",
  estimate = "diff",
  q = "q_BH",
  row_order = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  significant_colour = "significant",
  other_colour = "muted",
  label = "{diff|sf1}; p = {p|p}; q = {q_BH|p}",
  label_size = 4.6,
  label_x = 1.04,
  label_title = NULL,
  label_title_size = 4.8,
  span = 1.25,
  linewidth = 1.2,
  point_size = 11,
  marker = c("colour", "open"),
  segment_colour = "#C9C9C9",
  open_colour = "open_edge",
  open_size = 13,
  open_stroke = 0.7,
  x_limits = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  x_nbins = 6,
  x_label = NULL,
  grid = c("none", "x"),
  tick_size_y = 5,
  title_size = 5,
  box_mm = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Test table, one row per contrast.

row, estimate, q

Columns of the contrast, estimate and the (adjusted or nominal) P value compared with alpha.

row_order

Rows from top to bottom.

row_labels

Named tick labels.

alpha

Threshold for q.

significant_colour, other_colour

Colours.

label

Template written at the right (see FormatTemplate()).

label_size, label_x

Label size and position (panel fraction).

label_title

Optional column title written above the labels.

label_title_size

Its size.

span

Half-width of the axis relative to the largest absolute estimate.

linewidth, point_size

Segment width (points) and point area.

marker

"colour" or "open" (see Details).

segment_colour

Segment colour with marker = "open".

open_colour, open_size, open_stroke

Open points: edge colour, area and edge width.

x_limits

Optional x limits.

y_limits

Optional y limits (rows are at 1 to n from the bottom).

x_breaks, x_nbins

x ticks.

x_label

Axis title.

grid

"none" or "x" (vertical grid lines).

tick_size_y

Row label size.

title_size

Axis title size.

box_mm

Size of the data area c(width, height) in millimetres, passed by RenderFigure(); used by "auto" tick intervals (see NiceBreaks()).

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

t <- data.frame(contrast = c("A vs B", "C vs B"), diff = c(3.2, -1.1), p = c(0.01, 0.4),
                q_BH = c(0.03, 0.5))
PlotGroupDifferences(t)

PlotGroupDifferences(t, q = "p", marker = "open", label = "{p|p}", label_title = "P",
                     x_limits = c(-4, 4), grid = "x")
